note: Built on the classic Maracaibo conjuntos of the 1960s-80s: Ricardo Aguirre 'El Monumental' (with Cardenales del Éxito and Saladillo), the Cardenales, Estrellas del Zulia, early Guaco, Gran Coquivacoa's tamborera, Rincón Morales, Maracaibo 15 and Barrio Obrero's protest gaita 'Un ojo dimos'. Most tracks come from Discomoda and Foca compilations or digital reissues; years are the dates those pages give, null where only a compilation date was read.

size.basis: A judgement, not a count; written before collecting. Gaita zuliana has been recorded commercially since the 1960s and every Christmas season brings new LPs, then CDs and singles, from dozens of Maracaibo conjuntos (Cardenales del Éxito, Guaco, Maracaibo 15, Saladillo, Gran Coquivacoa, Barra de Maracaibo, Estrellas del Zulia and many more), each with long discographies of 10-12-track albums; add several hundred newer groups and singers and the regional labels' catalogues. An insider's essential list is about 60 recordings: the classic gaitas of Ricardo Aguirre, the Cardenales, Guaco's early gaita years, Maracaibo 15 and Saladillo, plus a few standards such as 'La grey zuliana' and 'Sentir zuliano'.
